verdict.rationale: Skyvern can be driven entirely through code, with no dashboard needed. It offers Python, TypeScript, and REST SDKs and a 'simple API' [skyvern-docs-1, skyvern-docs-17]. The SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP [skyvern-docs-5], and it can be self-hosted on your own servers with your own LLM keys [skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-2]. That covers the core of programmatic automation without a UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless browser mode, CI/CD pipeline integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
